title: Quarterly Sales Report
content: Sales have dropped significantly over the last 3 months. Marketing campaigns were reduced and competitors launched aggressive offers.

title: Customer Feedback Log
content: Many customers are saying prices are too high compared to other brands. They prefer cheaper alternatives.

title: Delivery Issues Report
content: Late deliveries and delayed shipments. Customers receiving orders after 10-12 days. Very frustrating experience.

title: Product Quality Review
content: Some products have inconsistent quality. Customers reported defects, broken items and poor durability.

title: Marketing Analysis
content: Reduced ad spend and less engagement on social media platforms. Campaigns are not reaching target audience.

title: Website Performance Report
content: Website loading time is very slow. Checkout process confusing. Users abandoning carts midway.

title: Customer Support Issues
content: Support team is not responding quickly. Long waiting times and unresolved complaints. Customers unhappy.

title: Competitor Analysis
content: Competitors offering heavy discounts, faster delivery and better service. Attracting our customers.

title: Return & Refund Complaints
content: Refund process is too slow. Takes 10 or more days. Customers losing trust in the brand.

title: Inventory Report
content: Frequent stock shortages. Popular items unavailable. Customers switching to other platforms.
